authors_reviews.title: Fair wet brush with some caveats for use and maintenance
authors_reviews.text: This flexible silicone brush does a good job of penetrating to the skin level of medium length hair. We're in the middle of winter and while there is a lot of shedding going on it's doesn't seem to be elevated by washing, so I can't speak to this reducing regular shedding. I also did not notice more hair being washed out in the bath versus just using my hands. It does make it easier on my hands and fingers to use the brush but you must be careful about sensitive areas. While the "bristles" are flexible they are still too aggressive for sensitive areas. It's relatively easy to grip and hold for the short amount of time it's used but improvement could be made my making the handle larger or oval shaped although the brush head it's self is a good size. My main complaint; if I had to find one and reason for only 4 stars, is that the brush is made in two parts that allows water to penetrate between the handle and brush. Having a wood handle would allow for rot over time. The solution is that we have to remove the silicone brush from the wooden handle and store separately after each use to allow to fully dry. This is inconvenient. We've only used the brush with bathing (a generous amount of shampoo also to keep the friction comfortable). When tried as a dry brush the friction and pull of the hair was uncomfortable for our dogs (Blue heeler, and Dachshunds). This brush did work awesome on getting the winter "mud etc." from the paw pads and toe crevices of all the dogs and it will be my go to for that purpose from now on. As an aside; and had no bearing on my review: I'm not a fan of the prominent branding of "Doggy style" on the brush. Sure this could be an innocent remark but is too full of innuendo for my taste with a household containing children and teens.
authors_reviews.author: Missali81

authors_reviews.title: Effective and gentle grooming brush for large dogs
authors_reviews.text: I ordered the bamboo bath scrubber for bathing my 1 year old Rottweiler and 10-year old Visla, and it works really well. The large size and soft silicone bristles make it easy to groom both dogs without causing discomfort.The brush provides a good massage while removing loose hair, and it distributes shampoo evenly, making bath time quicker and more enjoyable for the dogs. The bamboo handle feels sturdy and eco friendly, and the overall build quality is solid and comfortable to hold even when wet.Cleaning the brush is simple; hair rinses off easily, and it dries quickly between uses. It also seems durable, holding up well after multiple baths without losing its shape or bristles.In terms of value, this grooming brush is reasonably priced for a high-quality, eco-friendly option that makes bathing large dogs much easier.Overall, the Doggy Style bamboo bath scrubber combines comfort, durability, and efficiency, making it a reliable tool for regular pet grooming.
authors_reviews.author: Jos

authors_reviews.title: I love this hair-grabber brush, pup can’t deform it
authors_reviews.text: This is amazing- we got it for our labradoodle who tries to fight all the brushes we’ve tried & they inevitably end up with the spike side detached from the brush and the thick coarse hair side seized up with his hair. This one is great because the rubber bristles grab his undercoat & it rinses clean so I don’t think we’ll need to replace this one as often, if at all! He does still attack it, but he hasn’t managed to damage it at all & that’s a win in my book. When we bathe him, he doesn’t seem to be offended by it but just trying to brush him he definitely bites at it. Before this brush, after a bath there would be an enormous amount of fur coating the tub (& all over the walls after he shook) but the bath we gave him after using this one was less hair that I probably lose in my own showers. Great value, considering I don’t think I’ll need to replace this one

authors_reviews.author: Craig756

authors_reviews.title: My dog really enjoys this brush
authors_reviews.text: My dog really likes this brush! I do as well, because it is comfortable to hold. It feels nice in my hand, making it easy to brush my dog. She loves it so much that she lays down as soon as she sees me pick it up!The brush is made of bamboo and silicone and is a very nicely finished item. Aside from the dog sticker on the handle, I think the brush is sophisticated and aesthetically pleasing. Not that any of that matters to a dog, but since us humans have to buy their stuff, might as well get things that don't look terrible on the eyes.The silicone bristles are big and flexible enough that they don't scratch, but they are firm enough that they move the fur and leave brush marks behind. My dog really likes this one for having her back and belly "scratched." The silicone is pretty good at picking up loose fur too, so it functions with dual purpose - scratch those itchy spots and pick up some of the loose fur that would otherwise end up on the floor. The brush is easy to clean - just rinse it under water and air dry.I think $15 is a little steep for a simple dog brush, but since my dog really, really loves this one, I will say that it is a good value for the money. If she could speak, I think that's what she'd say.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer

authors_reviews.title: Nice brush, feels well made, dogs have no problem with me brushing them even outside bath time.
authors_reviews.text: This must feel nice to our dogs - they both want to be brushed by this (outside of bath time) and stand still for me to do so. This makes it a nice addition to our grooming tools, being both a bath brush and an everyday brush. It's easy to clean, and removes hair from their coats when used as an every day brush, which are two very nice perks for a house that fights dog hair constantly. The brush feels good in my hand, and makes it easy to brush under chins and necks. I've had no indications so far that it won't hold up, and I hope it stays that way.
